title: Alternative Splicing of TPM1 Mediated by SRPK3 Drives Cardiac Diastolic Dysfunction in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction.
text: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) has become the most prevalent type of heart failure, a condition characterized by impaired diastolic function and elevated left ventricular stiffness. TPM1 (tropomyosin 1), a crucial part of the thin filament in cardiomyocytes, has multiple alternative exons. However, the impact of TPM1 alternative splicing (AS) in HFpEF remains unclear.
